{{Quote|Advance Squad to General Unduli... ...the droid army has quickened its pace. E.T.A. at your location in less than one hour.|The squad's commander|<ref name="Hide in Plain Sight" />}}
'''Advance Squad''' was a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] that served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The squad was deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nadiem/Legends|Nadiem]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|21.6 BBY]], where they were the Republic troops closest to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] forces as well as the first to engage in the [[Battle of Nadiem]].

==History==
{{Quote|We've overtaken a group of refugees from one of the outlying settlements. One of them is sick. His illness delayed their progress to the evac site.|The squad's ARC commander speaking to Luminara Unduli over comms|<ref name="Hide in Plain Sight" />}}
Advance Squad was deployed to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nadiem/Legends|Nadiem]], where they were sent to evacuate [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] away from the planet in preparation for an imminent attack by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. While [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] led the evacuation in the town, the [[Squad/Legends|squad]] was out in an outlying settlement, where they rescued a few stragglers. However, one of the refugees was sick, which delayed their progress to the evac site, and as such Commander Offee was sent to rescue them from the incoming Separatist threat.<ref name="Hide in Plain Sight" />

Once the Separatists arrived, the squad set up an ambush with Barriss Offee. Their ambush entailed them playing dead. Once the Separatists walked past them, the troopers flanked around and planted [[Explosive charge/Legends|charges]] on their escape route. Following that, they hid on a hill in sniping positions.<ref name="Hide in Plain Sight" />

With their ambush, they thwarted the Separatist attack, destroying all of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Hide in Plain Sight" /> Despite their efforts, several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] died during the [[Battle of Nadiem]].<ref name="Star Wars: General Grievous">''[[Star Wars: General Grievous]]''</ref>
